subject: Access lockdown: SCIM & SAML assertion timeline + RBAC proof request
messages:
From: Alexandra Dunne <alexandra.dunne@securehealthit.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SCIM deltas + SAML assertion timeline for upcoming SIG review

Hi Marcus —

Hope you're well. We're finalizing the SIG/SOC2 intake for SecureHealth and need a short evidence bundle from Redwood for the access-control section. Would you be able to provide the following by COB Nov 3?

- SCIM delta extract for the last 90 days (user/service account adds/removes) scoped to the SecureHealth tenant. CSV is fine.
- A short SAML assertion timeline (UTC timestamps) showing assertion IDs and Subject NameIDs for any SSO events tied to SecureHealth over a recent 72-hour window — we just need examples (redact PII if necessary).
- RBAC ownership mapping for service accounts touching patient-data scopes and a brief justification of least-privilege decisions.

Also: point us to any runbook you use for emergency access lockdowns (steps we can show auditors). If you have a sample of the assertion log and a short narrative for how you handle ephemeral admin elevation, that would be ideal.

We can accept a Drive link. If parts of the artifacts are sensitive, let us know how you'd prefer us to consume them (redacted, redaction rules, or a live walkthrough).

If you can't hit Nov 3, please propose an alternative — our audit window is narrow.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation of scope and owners.

Alexandra Dunne
Security Compliance Manager
SecureHealth IT

Attachment: sig-intake-template.xlsx (reference)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Dunne <alexandra.dunne@securehealthit.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM deltas + SAML assertion timeline for upcoming SIG review

Alexandra —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the artifacts you requested. High-level plan:

1) SCIM delta (90d): Nai (cc'd) will pull a tenant-scoped CSV and redact email/local parts per our privacy rules.
2) SAML assertion timeline: we'll provide a 72-hour sample (UTC) with assertion IDs and Subject NameIDs redacted to hashed values.
3) RBAC ownership matrix: we'll export the service-account ownership sheet and include short owner notes + least-priv rationale.
4) Lockdown runbook: we'll share the internal emergency-access runbook (redacted for internal contact details) and a 10‑minute readme for auditors.

Deliverable format: Drive folder with three files + a one-page cover note that maps artifacts to SIG questions.

Target delivery: Nov 2 EOD PDT to give you a day to review before COB Nov 3. If that works, Nai will share the Drive link when ready.

cc: Irene — we'll need you to confirm the redaction rules for NameIDs and any additional legal constraints.

Marcus
Head of Security Programs (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Alexandra Dunne <alexandra.dunne@securehealthit.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM deltas + SAML assertion timeline for upcoming SIG review

Thanks Marcus — adding details on redaction and owners.

Quick bullets:
- NameID / PII redaction policy: we will replace email/localpart with a salted SHA256 hash and keep a mapping ledger internally for incident tracing. Hash salt will not be shared with auditors.
- SCIM deltas: export will include: timestamp (UTC), change_type (add/update/delete), object_type (User/ServiceAccount), external_id, acting_admin_id (hashed), source (provisioning/scim-sync/operator).
- SAML assertions: we will provide assertion ID, timestamp (UTC), issuer, destination, and hashed NameID + hashed Subject attributes. No raw token bodies.
- RBAC matrix: owner, role, grants, last reviewed timestamp, justification snippet (1-2 lines). We'll flag service accounts that have been granted patient-data scopes.
- Lockdown runbook: a redacted PDF describing steps (isolate node pool, revoke tokens, rotate service-account keys, require 2FA revalidation) and a short checklist for auditors.

Owner assignments: Nai (Naomi) — scim/saml extracts; Marcus — cover note + runbook redaction; Irene — RBAC export + justification snippets.

Naomi: please pull the scim-delta-90d.csv and saml-assertions-sample.txt and put them into the Drive folder below. Keep each file < 10MB and mark sensitive fields hashed.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Principal, Applied Security
Redwood Inference
